title: Microwave Egg Sandwich
summary: Cook one egg in a sprayed 6-oz ramekin in the microwave in short bursts, stir, top with salsa and cheese, melt the cheese, then slide the egg onto a lettuce-lined English muffin bottom and close with the muffin top.
source: CaptainCook4D recipe text + task graph (Microwave Egg Sandwich); mistake hints from train split

nodes.name: Pour 1 egg into ramekin
nodes.instruction_novice: Crack one egg on the counter edge and pour it into the sprayed ramekin, making sure no shell falls in.
substeps: Take one egg from the carton.
Tap it firmly once on a flat surface to crack it.
Open the shell over the ramekin and let the egg drop in.
Check for and remove any shell bits.
nodes.end_state: A single yolk and white sit in the bottom of the ramekin with no shell pieces visible.

checks.question: Is there exactly one yolk in the ramekin?
Is the ramekin free of eggshell pieces?
Did the egg go into the small ramekin rather than a bowl?

mistakes.description: Cracking two eggs into the ramekin instead of one.
mistakes.visual_cue: Two yolks visible in the ramekin, or a second egg being cracked over it.
mistakes.correction: That's two eggs. This recipe uses just one, so pour one out or start with a fresh ramekin.
mistakes.early_cue: A second egg is picked up after the first is already in the cup.

mistakes.description: Egg cracked into a bowl or large cup instead of the ramekin.
mistakes.visual_cue: Raw egg sits in a wide bowl or mug while the ramekin is empty.
mistakes.correction: The egg should go in the small ramekin, not the bowl. Pour it into the ramekin.
mistakes.early_cue: Egg is held over a bowl rather than the ramekin.

mistakes.description: Shell fragments left in the egg.
mistakes.visual_cue: White shell bits visible floating in the egg.
mistakes.correction: There's some shell in there. Scoop the bits out with a spoon before cooking.
mistakes.early_cue: Egg shattered unevenly during cracking.

mistakes.description: Egg cracked badly so it spills on the counter or floor.
mistakes.visual_cue: Raw egg running on the counter outside the ramekin.
mistakes.correction: That one spilled. Wipe it up, then crack a fresh egg gently over the ramekin.
mistakes.early_cue: Egg hit the counter edge too hard or opened away from the cup.

nodes.name: Place egg over the lettuce
nodes.instruction_novice: Slide the cooked egg out of the ramekin and set it on top of the lettuce on the muffin bottom.
substeps: Run a fork around the edge of the ramekin to loosen the egg.
Tip the ramekin over the lettuce-lined muffin bottom.
Let the egg drop onto the lettuce, cheese side up.
parts: English muffin bottom half with lettuce
nodes.end_state: The round egg with melted cheese sits on top of the lettuce on the muffin bottom, and the ramekin is empty.
nodes.view_hint: Muffin bottom on the plate from above.

checks.question: Is the egg sitting on top of the lettuce on the muffin bottom?
Is the ramekin now empty?

mistakes.description: Removing the lettuce, placing the egg on the bare muffin, then putting lettuce on top of the egg.
mistakes.visual_cue: Lettuce lifted off the muffin and later laid over the egg.
mistakes.correction: The lettuce goes under the egg. Put the lettuce back on the muffin first, then the egg on top.
mistakes.early_cue: Fingers pull the lettuce off the muffin before the ramekin is tipped.

mistakes.description: Egg left stuck in the ramekin, only partly transferred.
mistakes.visual_cue: Chunks of egg still in the ramekin while a broken piece sits on the muffin.
mistakes.correction: Loosen the rest with a fork and add it onto the lettuce too.
mistakes.early_cue: Ramekin tipped without loosening the egg first.

nodes.name: Coat ramekin with cooking spray
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab the small 6-ounce ramekin cup and give the inside a quick, even coat of cooking spray so the egg won't stick.
substeps: Pick up the small 6-oz ramekin, not a bowl or mug.
Hold the spray can a few inches above the cup.
Spray a short burst to lightly cover the bottom and sides.
nodes.end_state: The small ramekin sits on the counter with a glossy, lightly oiled interior.
nodes.view_hint: Looking down into the ramekin on the counter.

checks.question: Is the container a small 6-oz ramekin rather than a large bowl or cup?
Does the inside of the ramekin look shiny and coated with spray?

mistakes.description: Spraying a large bowl or big cup instead of the 6-oz ramekin.
mistakes.visual_cue: A wide bowl or tall mug is being held under the spray can instead of a small ramekin.
mistakes.correction: That's too big. Use the small 6-ounce ramekin instead and spray that one.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for a large bowl or mug instead of the ramekin.

mistakes.description: Skipping the spray and moving on with a dry ramekin.
mistakes.visual_cue: Ramekin interior looks dull and dry; spray can never picked up.
mistakes.correction: Give the ramekin a quick coat of cooking spray first so the egg won't stick.
mistakes.early_cue: Egg carton is opened before the spray can is touched.

nodes.name: Microwave 30 seconds uncovered
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the ramekin in the microwave with no cover and cook it on high for 30 seconds.
substeps: Place the ramekin in the center of the microwave, no lid or plate on top.
Set power to high.
Enter 30 seconds and start.
nodes.end_state: The microwave display shows the 30-second run finished and the egg has begun to turn opaque at the edges.
nodes.view_hint: Microwave control panel and the ramekin through the door.

checks.question: Is the ramekin inside the microwave without a cover?
Does the timer show 30 seconds was set?

mistakes.description: Setting only 10 or 15 seconds instead of 30.
mistakes.visual_cue: Microwave display shows 10 or 15 seconds counting down.
mistakes.correction: That's too short. Set it for 30 seconds on high.
mistakes.early_cue: Fingers press 1 then 0 or 1 then 5 on the keypad.

mistakes.description: Covering the ramekin with a lid or plate before microwaving.
mistakes.visual_cue: A plate or lid sits on top of the ramekin in the microwave.
mistakes.correction: Leave the cup uncovered for this step. Take that lid off.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up a lid or small plate near the ramekin.

nodes.name: Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cheese
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure one tablespoon of shredded cheese and sprinkle it evenly over the salsa and egg.
substeps: Fill the tablespoon measure with shredded cheese.
Sprinkle it with your fingers evenly over the top.
Don't pour straight from the bag.
nodes.end_state: A thin, even layer of shredded cheese covers the salsa and egg in the ramekin.

checks.question: Was the cheese measured with a tablespoon before adding?
Is the cheese spread evenly in a thin layer rather than a thick mound?

mistakes.description: Pouring cheese directly from the bag without measuring.
mistakes.visual_cue: Cheese bag tipped over the ramekin; no measuring spoon used.
mistakes.correction: Measure one tablespoon of cheese first instead of pouring from the bag.
mistakes.early_cue: Bag lifted over the ramekin with no spoon in hand.

mistakes.description: Adding two tablespoons of cheese.
mistakes.visual_cue: Second scoop of cheese added; thick pile heaped above the rim.
mistakes.correction: That's double the cheese. One tablespoon is enough, take some off.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon goes back to the cheese after the first sprinkle.

mistakes.description: Sprinkling cheese before the egg was microwaved.
mistakes.visual_cue: Cheese being added to raw, liquid egg.
mistakes.correction: Wait on the cheese. Cook and stir the egg first, add salsa, then cheese.
mistakes.early_cue: Cheese bag opened while the egg is still raw.

nodes.name: Top with 1 tablespoon salsa
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure one tablespoon of salsa and spoon it on top of the egg in the ramekin.
substeps: Pick up the tablespoon measure.
Fill it level with salsa.
Spoon it over the egg in the ramekin.
nodes.end_state: A single tablespoon-sized dollop of red salsa sits on top of the cooked egg in the ramekin.

checks.question: Is a tablespoon measure being used for the salsa?
Is there roughly one tablespoon of salsa on the egg, not a thin smear or a large pile?
checks.roi: top of the egg in the ramekin

mistakes.description: Using a teaspoon or half tablespoon, too little salsa.
mistakes.visual_cue: Small spoon used; only a tiny streak of salsa on the egg.
mistakes.correction: That's not quite enough. Use a full tablespoon of salsa.
mistakes.early_cue: Smallest measuring spoon picked from the set.

mistakes.description: Adding two or three tablespoons of salsa.
mistakes.visual_cue: Multiple scoops added; salsa covers the egg thickly and nearly fills the cup.
mistakes.correction: That's too much salsa. Scrape some off so there's about one tablespoon.
mistakes.early_cue: Measuring spoon returns to the salsa jar after the first scoop.

mistakes.description: Adding salsa before the egg has finished cooking.
mistakes.visual_cue: Salsa being spooned onto a still-runny egg.
mistakes.correction: The egg isn't set yet. Finish microwaving it first, then add the salsa.
mistakes.early_cue: Salsa jar opened while the egg is still in the microwave or runny.

nodes.name: Replace muffin top
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the top half of the English muffin on the egg, cut side down, to close the sandwich.
nodes.instruction_expert: Top half on, cut side down
substeps: Pick up the rounded top half.
Hold it with the cut side facing down.
Set it on the egg to close the sandwich.
nodes.end_state: A closed sandwich with the domed muffin top facing up sits on the plate.
nodes.view_hint: The sandwich on the plate from the side and above.

checks.question: Is the domed, crusty side of the muffin top facing up?
Is the piece on top the rounded top half rather than another flat bottom?

mistakes.description: Muffin top placed upside down with the cut side facing up.
mistakes.visual_cue: Pale, craggy cut surface visible on top of the sandwich.
mistakes.correction: That top is upside down. Flip it so the cut side touches the egg.
mistakes.early_cue: Top half picked up with the cut side facing the ceiling.

mistakes.description: Using a bottom half as the top piece.
mistakes.visual_cue: The piece on top is flat with no dome; a rounded top half remains on the board.
mistakes.correction: That's a bottom piece. Use the rounded top half to close the sandwich.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for the flat half left on the board.

mistakes.description: Closing the sandwich before the egg has been added.
mistakes.visual_cue: Muffin top placed on bare lettuce while the egg is still in the ramekin.
mistakes.correction: The egg isn't in yet. Lift the top, add the egg onto the lettuce, then close it.
mistakes.early_cue: Top half picked up while the ramekin still holds the egg.

nodes.name: Microwave 15-30 seconds until almost set
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the ramekin back in and microwave for 15 to 30 more seconds, just until the egg is almost set but still a little soft on top.
substeps: Return the uncovered ramekin to the microwave.
Set 15 to 30 seconds on high.
Check that the egg is mostly firm with a slightly soft top.
nodes.end_state: The egg in the ramekin is puffed and mostly firm, with only a slightly glossy soft spot in the center.
nodes.view_hint: Microwave display, then looking down into the ramekin after the door opens.

checks.question: Was the timer set between 15 and 30 seconds?
Does the egg look mostly set with no large runny area?
Is the ramekin still free of cheese and salsa?

mistakes.description: Microwaving for a full minute, overcooking the egg.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display shows 1:00; egg puffs high and looks dry and rubbery.
mistakes.correction: That's too long. Use 15 to 30 seconds so the egg stays tender.
mistakes.early_cue: Keypad entry of 1-0-0 or the 1 minute quick button.

mistakes.description: Microwaving less than 15 seconds so the egg is still runny.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display shows under 15 seconds; egg still liquid in the center.
mistakes.correction: The egg is still runny. Give it another 15 seconds or so until it's almost set.
mistakes.early_cue: Only a single digit entered on the keypad.

mistakes.description: Adding cheese or salsa before this cook.
mistakes.visual_cue: Shredded cheese or salsa visible on the egg as it goes into the microwave.
mistakes.correction: Hold off on toppings. Cook the egg until almost set first, then add salsa and cheese.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for cheese bag or salsa jar before the ramekin goes back in.

nodes.name: Line muffin bottom with lettuce
nodes.instruction_novice: Take the bottom half of the muffin and lay a piece of lettuce on its cut side.
substeps: Pick the bottom half, the flatter one.
Set it cut-side up.
Lay a lettuce leaf on top to cover it.
nodes.end_state: A lettuce leaf sits on the cut side of the bottom muffin half, with the top half set aside.
nodes.view_hint: Muffin halves on the board or plate from above.

checks.question: Is the lettuce on the bottom half, not the domed top half?
Is lettuce present on the muffin?

mistakes.description: Putting the lettuce on the top half instead of the bottom.
mistakes.visual_cue: Lettuce lies on the domed, rounded top half while the flat bottom is bare.
mistakes.correction: That's the top half. Move the lettuce to the flatter bottom half.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up the rounded top half first.

mistakes.description: Skipping the lettuce entirely.
mistakes.visual_cue: Bare muffin bottom with no lettuce as the egg is about to go on.
mistakes.correction: Add a piece of lettuce to the bottom half before the egg goes on.
mistakes.early_cue: Ramekin picked up while the muffin bottom is still bare.

nodes.name: Microwave about 10 seconds to melt cheese
nodes.instruction_novice: Pop the ramekin back in the microwave for about 10 seconds, just until the cheese melts.
substeps: Return the ramekin to the microwave.
Set about 10 seconds.
Look for the cheese to turn glossy and melted, then stop.
nodes.end_state: The cheese on top of the egg looks shiny and melted into the salsa.
nodes.view_hint: Microwave display, then looking down into the ramekin.

checks.question: Was the timer set to around 10 seconds?
Does the cheese look melted and glossy rather than dry shreds?

mistakes.description: Microwaving 30 seconds or more, until the egg is hard.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display shows 30 seconds or more; egg puffs high and cheese bubbles and browns.
mistakes.correction: Only about 10 seconds here, just enough to melt the cheese.
mistakes.early_cue: Keypad entry of 3-0 or higher.

mistakes.description: Taking it out before the cheese has melted.
mistakes.visual_cue: Cheese still looks like loose dry shreds on top.
mistakes.correction: The cheese isn't melted yet. Give it a few more seconds.
mistakes.early_cue: Door opened after only a couple of seconds.

nodes.name: Stir the egg
nodes.instruction_novice: Take the ramekin out and gently stir the egg with a fork or spoon to mix the cooked edges into the runny center.
substeps: Carefully remove the hot ramekin.
Use a fork or spoon, not a knife.
Stir slowly a few times until mixed.
nodes.end_state: The egg in the ramekin looks evenly mixed and partly cooked, with a fork or spoon resting nearby.

checks.question: Is a fork or spoon, not a knife, being used to stir?
Does the egg look evenly mixed with no large unmixed runny pool?

mistakes.description: Stirring with a knife instead of a fork or spoon.
mistakes.visual_cue: A knife blade is in the ramekin moving the egg.
mistakes.correction: Swap that knife for a fork or spoon to stir the egg.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up a knife after opening the microwave.

mistakes.description: Stirring too rapidly so egg splashes out.
mistakes.visual_cue: Fast whipping motion with egg flicking onto the rim or counter.
mistakes.correction: Slow down, just a few gentle stirs so it doesn't splash.
mistakes.early_cue: Rapid wrist movement as soon as the utensil enters the cup.

nodes.name: Cut English muffin in two
nodes.instruction_novice: Lay the English muffin flat and cut it into a top and bottom half with a knife.
substeps: Place the muffin flat on the cutting board.
Hold it steady with one hand.
Slice horizontally through the middle with the knife to make two even halves.
nodes.end_state: Two even English muffin halves lie cut-side up on the board with a knife beside them.

checks.question: Was a knife used to split the muffin?
checks.roi: knife and muffin on the board

checks.question: Are there exactly two roughly equal muffin halves?

mistakes.description: Tearing the muffin apart by hand instead of using a knife.
mistakes.visual_cue: Both hands pulling the muffin apart; ragged torn edges and no knife on the board.
mistakes.correction: Use the knife to cut the muffin so you get clean, even halves.
mistakes.early_cue: Muffin picked up with both hands while the knife stays on the counter.

mistakes.description: Cutting into three pieces or two very uneven pieces.
mistakes.visual_cue: Three muffin pieces on the board, or one thick half and one thin sliver.
mistakes.correction: You want two even halves, a top and a bottom. Try slicing straight through the middle.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife enters the muffin off-center or at an angle.
